name: Wasp_Get Part Geometry
brief: Wasp_Get Part Geometry | Inputs: PART -> GEO
context: Wasp plugin component: extracts placed geometry from aggregated parts. Transforms abstract WaspPart objects into world-space geometry for visualization or further processing.
solution_principle: Extracts and transforms the underlying geometry of placed WaspPart objects to their world-space positions. Parts are abstract objects with position/orientation data until this component makes geometry accessible. Wire from Stochastic Aggregation PART_OUT, then to Custom Preview with ColourSwatch for display.
anti_patterns: Wiring AGGR output instead of PART_OUT -- AGGR is the aggregation object, not parts
Expecting geometry directly from aggregation without this extraction step
